text: This is a handy little gadget. I've used this type of coffee pour over for years, mainly the plastic ones made by Melitta. However, this one has a base that could be wider. Some of my coffee mugs have wide mouths and this product falls into those cups. But for a smaller cup mouth, it works just great. Saves on filters.
Perfect for coffee.  No gluttony here.  Just one cup.  Give it a minute or two to drip completely through.
Fast drip but coffee was not wasted. Had a group of Brazilian s here and they loved it for their coffee.  They drink coffee all day long.  Gave one away to them.
Just what i was looking for, works as expected and good quality.
Simple design & use. I can have a single cup of my preferred coffee or tea blend at work or home without  a lot of fuss.
Works great!
Love it. Simple and easy.

This is a fabulous paper-free filter, that will serve for a lifetime. For reference - is the size of a #2 Melitta filter (single-cup size.) The filter is double-layer: a perforated layer of s/s outside, and a layer of incredibly fine s/s wire screen on the inside. I love it. Shipping was very fast, and the item arrived unscathed.

I had my doubts about this one but was amazed at how well my coffee tasted (at least the second cup did).  I gave it a five star but there were no directions included so I really meant 4 1/2.  After I figured out how much water to use and how to pour it I LOVE IT!!!! It is so simple to use. Not a big deal to wipe it out and rinse to clean it but I might try coffee filters too.

I had this sitting in my wish list for a while and then it went on a lightning deal, so I had to snatch one up. The material feels like it is made from quality materials, and the filter works really well. I feel like I have less coffee soot at the bottom of my cup than I do with a French Press or greca/stovetop espresso maker, and I get a quality cup as I do with the press and greca. Definitely worth the price, especially if it goes for 50% off again!
Great quality.  Perfect for camping

Went on a three night backpacking trip in the marble mountains (sky high lakes) One of my friends brought a jet boil French press and I brought this and just a jet boil. I ended up making coffee for everyone, everyone loved this! Probably one of my favorite backpacking-gear buys. 👌🏽👌🏽 good quality!

Coffee tasted excellent!
Prefer to make one cup at a time, makes a nice cup each and every time!
So handy for our trip! No filters, no glass to break and coffee tastes great!
I love it. It makes a great tasting cup of coffee and no expensive cone shaped filters to buy. fast and efficient.

This is just what I was looking for--I'd been using a plastic dripper and paper filters for longer than I care to admit. I love the simplicity of this device and method. A couple weeks in, the quality seems solid. The four spot welds attaching the cone to the base don't look exceptionally sturdy, but they're probably up to the task. Mine didn't come with instructions; that's not a big deal, but I always like to know how the vendor recommends using their device. The scoop looks and feels good--it's a nice addition. Despite the two-layer filter, this drips a good bit faster than a paper filter in a plastic dripper. I've taken to a continuous slow pour instead of two successive full pours, to prolong the contact between the grounds and the water. Overall, I'm quite satisfied.
Exactly what I wanted, a pour over filter that I didn't have to use a paper filter with to avoid having grounds in my coffee!

This thing works great. I get a perfect cup of coffee every time I use it. I've read some reviews on these by other people about coffee not being strong enough. Not sure why and not sure if it was even this particular one. Maybe not enough coffee used in the device? More than likely though they either poured too much water too quickly and went past the top of the grounds. Perhaps they forgot that the device is perforated all the way to the top? Or they were using a large size teapot that's harder to control and get precise pours. If one has a little patience then this will give you a perfect cup of coffee every time. No patience? Then stick with instant coffee.

It's rare to find a solution that so greatly enhances something already enjoyed on a daily basis for decades, however, the SSI Pour Over Coffee Filter Dripper Kit fits the bill. Since receiving this from Amazon, it's been used multiple times a day and still looks as good as the day it arrived. This package includes not only the pour over coffee filter dripper but also a beautiful measuring scoop. Admittedly, after using this a few times, I find the scoop less than necessary as can eyeball the measurement, however I've continued using it when making more than one cup at a time. Absolutely FANTASTIC!

This came in an attractive gift box, without any instructions, then again a hat or a cup wouldn't come with instructions so I set out to find out how this works. The video shows my FIRST time using this, and I'd intended to recreate this once I got to using it more, however there's no difference. I'll detail further what I've learned to create the best cups of coffee everytime using this. Inside the box were well wrapped filter system along with the scoop which is shiny stainless steel. The filter itself is elegant and well crafted and rather exciting!

The biggest TIP I can point out: WET the coffee. This coffee drip system will make coffee perfectly no matter how quickly you pour, or how you use it, but getting the grounds wet (meaning splash some water on it, wait a few seconds, then start
This stopped working after 1-week usage, it no longer allows the coffee to drip through.

At first I was a little disappointed in finding that the temperature measurement was 2 degrees high. I expected better. I went to the Acurite website and found that the accuracy specification for the device was +/- 2 degrees thru the temperature range of 32 degrees F to 80 degrees F. So the device did meet its accuracy specification. I expected too much for the price. As an electrical engineer that spent a career designing measurement instruments, I should have recalled that a temperature sensor alone with a measurement accuracy specification better than +/- 5 degrees F would cost more than I paid for this meter.. That's why more accurate meters are calibrated for accuracy and cost more because of the labor cost of calibration. You get what you pay for, and at ten dollars this device meets specifications at a modest price. Hence four stars. Good device for the money if you can accept temperature accuracy of +/- 2 degrees. I note that the manufacturer's specification for humidity accuracy is +/- 10%. Seems reasonable, if you need more accuracy, get out the pocket book.

I ordered a pair of them about 3 weeks ago.  The summary is - they read 4 degrees low (Fahrenheit) compared to my house thermostat and a local clock / thermometer.  They arrived on time and were packaged well.  I like the display, easy to read.  The high and low for the day appear to be right.  We have a lower temperature at night, and the "low" appeared to be accurate (but 4 degrees low).  After they acclimated to the house temperature I balanced them on top of the house thermostat.  They both read 4 degrees low.  I then placed them next to my clock / thermometer and they read 4 degrees low.  The humidity reading was 2% different between them when I had them side by side.  I will have to watch the humidity for a while to determine whether it is useful.  I give the product 3 stars due to the temperature difference.  I think I can use them because they are consistently 4 degrees low and I can automatically make the adjustment when I view one of them.

I now have four of these in different rooms of my house. Then I regulate the central thermostat to the desired temperature range for the room where the thermostat is located. I then manually adjust the registers in each room to reduce or increase the air flow so that the desired temperature for that room is obtained. These monitors are also great for monitoring humidity levels. I can adjust the water flow into my central humidifier (attached to the furnace) in the winter to keep adequate moisture (about 40% humidity in my case) in the air. In the summer, I set my two dehumidifiers (one for each level in my house) at the desired humidity (50% in my case).

I also put one in my mother's room at her assisted living facility. This helped me to alert the caregivers and building operations manager when the temperature became too hot or too cold. I also was able to alert the ops manager last week when the humidity level had fallen too low (27%). He has notified his corporate contact and they are now working on getting a humidifier for the furnace.

(Edit) After allowing almost a week for these to get their act together, they're going back. They sit within 18" of each other 2 degrees apart on the temperature and 5% off on the humidity. Trash would be too kind a word.

I use my Keurig frequently and must admit that I have not been very good about changing the filters with great regularity. Part of the problem was that these cost so much through the Keurig site. Keurig really is a pretty big waste of money but man do I love the convenience. I certainly do not miss dealing with filters. The price is just right for this large pack. These will last you quite a while. With this pack of twelve filters, I will now be changing them with greater frequency. They also come with an electronic book or two? I am not sure because I did not even look at them. They did get emailed to me after the purchase, however, so if you do have interest in the book you will get it.

I received this product - Replacement Charcoal Filters for Keurig 2.0 with Single Serving Bulletproof Coffee and 10 Single Serving Coffee Ebooks - for free or at a discount in exchange for a review. However, I am very happy that I found this product and I do think that the regular price is more than fair. Although I do agree to leave a review, I do not agree to leave a favorable review unless I feel the product deserves it. In this case, this is a five star product with or without the discount.

This is a super value for a years worth of charcoal filters. Most of these kitchen gadgets and the like gouge you on consumables. This is not the case with these. They are well made and do the job. These do not come with instructions, but they can be found on the Keurig site or by looking on Y-tube. They fit exactly the same as the OEM filters, but cost a lot less.
